scope: Execute the qualified NTFS ordinary-file bootstrap in an actual owned Windows observation-worker process. Advance original NTFS interpretation toward frontend admission; public command dispatch, namespace/content, physical media and effects remain separate work.
input: Own a nonzero capture epoch, exact expected ordinary-file metadata, path, volume window, Automatic/Version30/Version31 selector and finite NtfsCaptureLimits. Validate strict wire shapes and bounds before spawning. Expected metadata is a precondition, not source authority. Normal binaries reject all test fixture selections.
host: Reuse ObservationWorker and its compiled roles, owned launch/session, executable hash, host/request/attempt/observer/worker/capture identities, explicit inherited handles, process/job budgets, cancellation and finite retirement. No second process scheduler or external role selector. Prepare is inert with respect to source reads; source opens only in the released worker. A live or uncertain worker does not publish a usable snapshot.
frame: A private bounded frame carries exact input/epoch, actual process identity, the file-adapter result and every retained response including offset, requested bytes, native error, seek/read attempts, refusal and bytes. Use a finite compiled payload mapping and canonical SHA256 publication. Parent checks strict publication/frame/input shapes, exact limits/window/source metadata, process identity against its held child, source/domain and all false safety claims. Validate finite region count/aggregate requested bytes before replay. No parent native source reads during verification.
replay: Reconstruct the selected observation from exact retained responses with the existing pure NTFS observer. Check request order, identity/window and complete response consumption, selected/automatic profile relationships, replay counts, source metadata completeness/equality, binding/stability flags and capture domain. Incomplete/refused observations may remain inspectable without applicability. Adapter replay/profile disagreement is rejected rather than repaired. Metadata/binding disagreement withdraws applicability exactly as the adapter does. Frame replay proves recorded facts, not renewed source authority or producer authenticity.
publication: Return an immutable private snapshot only after a completed validated publication from the exited owned process. Bind context to the actual request, code, process and epochs. Preserve exact retirement outcome; cancellation/timeout/exit/corruption remain distinguishable. Retained snapshots survive worker teardown. No public dispatch/effect/atomic snapshot/whole-filesystem claim follows.
bounds: Input mapping128KiB, payload8MiB, finite128MiB process/job budget from the common host; source read/retention/attribute/run/output budgets remain the original NtfsCaptureLimits. Canonical frame encoder and decoder cap values, depth and strings. Do not enlarge source read budgets or timeouts to make a test pass. In-process replay/serialization are bounded work, not an OS CPU deadline.
testing: Separate normal/fault libraries and probes. Generated ordinary images only. Exercise real child entry/exit/PID/creation, inherited handle/job closure, source preservation,3.0/3.1 auto/explicit mismatch, fragmented geometry and nonzero windows; strict input/frame corruption, unavailable source, cancellation, live timeout/late/exit, startup failure and zero-time retirement. Retain original failures. Normal code has no fault-enabling environment/request protocol. Existing NTFS, ordinary-file, exFAT-worker and common-worker regressions remain applicable.
acceptance: Actual owned normal worker publishes a frame whose retained bytes reproduce independent generated bootstrap facts for both versions and explicit/automatic selection; parent verifies exact source and actual kernel process identity. Source bytes unchanged.

Wrong input/epoch/source/domain/limits/process, malformed response extents/bytes/attempts, changed observations/receipts/claims and publication digest fail closed without a usable snapshot. Structurally valid incomplete observations retain diagnostics without permission claims.

Cancellation, hang, late response, abrupt child exit and pre/post-spawn startup faults preserve typed observations and actual retirement. No live/uncertain worker or invalid reply produces a snapshot; retained valid snapshots survive teardown.

Source-bound compiler/build/native/header/import/dependency/context evidence and implementing-agent review. Main promotion remains withheld until W075/report-preparation is resolved and whole-branch checks pass. No owner/platform/storage/release acceptance is manufactured.
